values.note: Operator's rates page (the same in its April 2026 Wayback capture, during the 2026 season): 'starting at' $42 for a 20-amp electric site, $45 30-amp electric, $50 water and electric, $55 lakeside; rustic tent sites $35; camping cabins $100-125. Visitors $5 per person per day. A 2025 holiday surcharge (+$5 a night) is no longer shown.

values.note: Book online through the operator's ResNexus page ('Book Now!') or by phone; no regular office hours off-season. 2027 reservations open Monday, January 11, 2027 at 8 a.m. Paid in full at booking. Arrival after 2 p.m., departure by 11 a.m. Eastern.

booking.source: https://otterlakemichigan.com/ ('Reservations for the 2027 camping season will open on Monday, January 11, 2027 at 8:00 AM', 'Online booking is recommended') + https://otterlakemichigan.com/rates-reservations.html ('At booking, reservations must be paid in full') + site-map-rules.html, read 2026-10-22

note: Private 92-acre campground on Otter Lake near Hiawatha NF and Pictured Rocks, Munising; 50+ sites plus camping cabins. Direct ORV trail access; kayak/canoe/SUP/rowboat rentals; swimming area with no lifeguard; electric trolling motors only on the lake. --Claude
summary: Operator's site confirms the 2026 season May 21-Sep 30, rates $42 (20A electric) to $55 lakeside (same in the April 2026 Wayback capture, so dated 2026), 20/30-amp electric and water/electric sites, showers, laundry, camp store, online booking via ResNexus (2027 opens Jan 11, 2027); phone (906) 387-4648 matches. ResNexus showed a captcha, so no engine quote. Not stated by the operator: dump station, pull-throughs, max rig 45 ft (all from note prose, left). Note cleaned of the site-type, amenity, season and booking text the fields hold. Pictured Rocks gateway (13 km); base $42 is under the gate anyway. Ordinary transient park, no seasonal sites mentioned.
